segments.text: The artist Van Gogh could barely sell any of his paintings during his lifetime.
He was rejected and criticized by ordinary people and experienced severe mental distress.
Just before he took his own life at 37, he had sold only one painting
Without the support of his brother Theo, he could not even have bought paint
Despite all this, Van Gogh created about two 100 works in 10 years
Paintings and drawings and an enormous number together
His dedication was not in pursuit of success
Decades after his death, his paintings began to be reevaluated
Today, some flowers and the starry night are counted among the most popular paintings in the world
They are traded for billions of yen each
While Van Gogh was alive
Few people recognized his potential
His brother Theo was one of the few exceptions
Theo believed in his brother's talent
And that considerable sacrifice kept deporting him
Van Gogh's story asks about the definition of success
Is success to be recognized in life?
Is success to be recognized after death?
Perhaps for Van Gogh himself, success was to keep painting
Whatever the reaction of the world he kept painting according to his inner voice
That was the integrity of his life
We can see the truth of a human being in the canvases van Gogh left behind
Colors that seem to yell, a life force that seems to burst
Instead of staying silent, he continues to speak to the world through his paintings.
